description: LIVE EU VAT number validation against VIES, the European Commission's official service — not a format check: the number is verified in the member state's actual register, returning the registered trader name and address where published. Covers all 27 member states plus Northern Ireland (XI). Essential before B2B invoicing with reverse charge. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

country.description: Two-letter member state code if not included in vat_number (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland)

vat_number.description: VAT number, with or without the country prefix, e.g. RO12345678

name: agentbit.vat_check
title: EU VAT Validation
